preconditions.description: The input k must be an integer between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of vertices n in the output graph must be between 2 and 1000 inclusive.
The number of lines in the output must be equal to the number of vertices n plus one.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line) == int(stdout.split()[0]) for line in stdout.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each line of the adjacency matrix must have a length equal to the number of vertices n.

postconditions.expression: all(line[i] in ['N', 'Y'] for line in stdout.split()[1:] for i in range(len(line)))
postconditions.description: Each element of the adjacency matrix must be either 'N' or 'Y'.

postconditions.expression: all(line[i] == line[i] for line in stdout.split()[1:] for i in range(len(line)))
postconditions.description: The adjacency matrix must be symmetric (G_{ij} = G_{ji}).

postconditions.expression: all(line[i] == 'N' for line in stdout.split()[1:] for i in range(len(line)) if i == int(line.split()[0]) - 1)
postconditions.description: There must be no self-loops in the graph (G_{ii} = 'N').
There must be an edge between vertex 1 and vertex 2 (G_{12} = 'Y').

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for line in stdout.split()[1:] if line[1] == 'Y') == int(stdin.split()[0])
postconditions.description: There must be exactly k shortest paths between vertex 1 and vertex 2.
